package rest

import sieve "sieve.client"

type Result struct {
	value interface{}
	err   error
}

func (r Result) Get() (interface{}, error) { return r.value, r.err }
func (r Result) Error() error              { return r.err }

type Request struct {
	verb, pathPrefix, subpath, namespace, resource, resourceName, subresource string
	namespaceSet                                                              bool
	obj                                                                       interface{} //sieve
	payload                                                                   interface{}
}

func (r *Request) Body(obj interface{}) *Request {
	r.obj = obj //sieve
	r.payload = obj
	return r
}
func (r *Request) request() Result { return Result{value: r.payload} }
func (r *Request) Do() Result {
	operationID := sieve.NotifyTestBeforeRestCall(r.verb, r.pathPrefix, r.subpath, r.namespace, r.namespaceSet, r.resource, r.resourceName, r.subresource, r.obj) //sieve
	result := r.request()
	resultObj, decodingError := result.Get()                                                                                                                                                      //sieve
	sieve.NotifyTestAfterRestCall(operationID, r.verb, r.pathPrefix, r.subpath, r.namespace, r.namespaceSet, r.resource, r.resourceName, r.subresource, resultObj, decodingError, result.Error()) //sieve
	return result
}
